title: DLT pipeline inserts pipeline Update ID into the table name and raises permission denied error on it
question:
I have a DLT pipeline in Databricks that I am trying to execute - not for the first time as it has worked before, but I'm seeing this strange behaviour in the pipeline such that it uses the Update ID in the table name along with __staging_ and then it raises an error on it that permission is denied for this table on __databricks_internal. Anyone knows the cause of the problem and how it might be resolved? My account has the permissions needed and I tried fully cleaning and destroying my environment to see if that fixes it but it still persists.

I included the error message below.

Thanks for help in advance!
answer: Look who is the owner of the database schema. In Databricks: Tab "Catalog" -> Navigate to your catalog -> navigate to your schema -> Under the tab "Overview" in the section "About this schema" you can see the owner. I assume that there is an unknown owner or a user group that you do not belong to.
